run_knn_search: run a brute-force k-nearest neighbor search between query and database vectors using L2 or inner product metric
build_kmeans_clustering: build a Kmeans object to cluster vectors into k centroids and assign new vectors to nearest centroid
compute_pairwise_distances: compute the full pairwise distance matrix between two sets of vectors using L2 or inner product
find_kmin_kmax: find the k smallest or largest values and their indices across each row of a float32 array
merge_knn_results: merge sorted KNN results from multiple dataset shards into a single top-k result set using ResultHeap
